mixed.ngram: SSD mmap, ngram_table.bin, ple-gpu disabled, MLX_SERVE_NGRAM_WARM=0

quality: 6 deterministic smoke tasks plus 96 sampled next-token predictions from fixed Chinese/English/code reference text; report coverage and missing targets, do not mislabel truncated logprobs as full-corpus perplexity
limitations: different inference engines; this is deployment comparison, not isolated weight comparison
real public text/code prefixes, not a full long-document comprehension benchmark
OS page cache is not force-cleared; process-cold is not SSD-cold
long-context failures must be reported, not silently omitted
verification: downloaded weight SHA-256 must match original Hugging Face API metadata even when hf-mirror resolver is used

corpora.code: CPython v3.12.0 Lib/*.py sorted paths, excluding test directory

long_context_check: Three deterministic verification codes inserted near beginning, middle and end of each real-corpus speed prompt; record per-code retrieval. This is not a general comprehension benchmark.

execution_order.modes: baseline both models first, then MTP; restart model for each context batch
